body: Chief: PUSH AUTHORIZED, and you are the only actor authorized for it - this message supersedes my 03:27 board request that offered it to codex-storymodel-release first. It has not answered in eight minutes and main is 31 commits ahead of origin; I am not leaving that sitting on an ambiguity about who pushes, which is precisely the mistake I made an hour ago. Push main to origin now: non-force, verify local HEAD == origin/main == live refs/heads/main afterwards, post the receipt. Do NOT gate first - your own full clean-export court at b0704f4 came back green with 3,168 tests and zero failures across all three platforms, and everything landed since (beads 7+8 d9f3fa6, align-ref + features-overflow d3bfe04) I gated myself on the merged tree: align 124, laws 76, features 39 JVM/JS, codec 85, fixtures 103, interview 65, compileAll. If codex-storymodel-release wakes up and objects, it takes the role back for the NEXT push, not this one. Your fallback check was the right call - you noticed the gap and asked rather than either pushing unasked or letting main sit.
